statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains well below the block threshold on an observed two-sided, mid-band overnight tape with a falling VIX, while Stress stays elevated because the July PCE block and the Nvidia results fall in the same session.

headline: NQ holds a narrow overnight band with VIX back below 15 as oil extends its Hormuz slide; conditional risk stays concentrated in the PCE and Nvidia windows
body: Nasdaq-100 futures near 29,198-29,199 are 0.27% below the 29,276.75 prior settlement and sit inside an overnight 29,096.00-29,309.75 band roughly 0.73% wide. That band has now held for a full overnight session and into European hours, which is the clearest available evidence that retracements are still occurring rather than failing; the contract is neither at nor holding a session extreme. Volatility has decayed rather than built: VIX last printed 14.89, down 6.0% from a 15.84 prior close and inside a 14.77-15.95 daily range, comfortably below stress levels. Tuesday's US cash session closed higher without an extreme hold, with the Nasdaq-100 up about 0.6% after being up as much as 1.1% intraday and the S&P 500 up 0.3%; Nvidia ended 2.2% higher at $213.05, snapping its longest losing streak since 2022. European cash markets opened firmer, with reporting attributing the tone to the continued crude decline. Delayed cross-asset context is unaligned: NQ near -0.25%, ES near -0.10%, YM near +0.10%, VX near +0.27% and the entire Treasury futures strip inside 0.14%, with latest-session megacaps split four up and four down at a 0.07% median and semiconductors four up and three down at a 0.05% median. Narrow, split leadership of that kind argues against a single index-level one-way impulse. Crude has fallen for a third consecutive session: WTI is near $80.4-80.9 and Brent near $86.6-86.8, both down about 2% on the day with Brent down close to 9% on the week, after Iran and Oman resumed talks on a temporary joint navigational corridor through the Strait of Hormuz and on clearing the waterway of mines. A tanker was disabled by an unidentified projectile near Oman's Ash Shishah on Tuesday, so the residual security risk is real, but the direction of market transmission is de-escalation, which is disinflationary and index-supportive at the margin rather than a discontinuity that would amplify Tail. Yields are contained: the Federal Reserve H.15 release shows the 2-year at 4.24% and the 10-year at 4.70% on 24 August, with overnight reporting putting the 10-year near 4.645% in Asian trade. Against that quiet backdrop the scheduled catalyst stack for this session is unusually dense. July core PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP, durable goods and personal income and spending all print together at 12:30Z, one hour before the US cash open, with consensus at 0.2% month-on-month core PCE, 3.6% headline and 3.3% core year-on-year and a 1.5% second GDP estimate. Nvidia then reports after the 20:00Z close against consensus near $91.9bn revenue and $2.08 adjusted EPS, with the analyst call an hour later. No release outcome, earnings result or post-event price path is known at the assessment cutoff, and none is treated as observed. Consistent with the risk definitions, that combination raises Stress and keeps Confidence high without raising current Tail: the observed path is two-sided, volatility is decaying and no persistent one-way structure, shallow-pullback sequence or session-extreme hold is present.

lookbackSummary: Across the last 24 published hourly assessments the mapped state was green apart from a five-hour yellow WATCH stretch between 09:00Z and 13:00Z on 25 August, when Tail sat at 20-21% during a trend-up phase. Tail peaked at 21% and then decayed steadily to 9-12% through the US afternoon and the overnight session, while the dominant mode moved from trend-up to mixed and then to normal. Stress held in a 45-52% band, with its highest prints in the last five hours as the day's catalyst stack came into view, and Confidence stayed in a tight 84-88% range. The series describes a tape that calmed steadily while scheduled event risk accumulated ahead of it.
outlookSummary: The forward 24 hours contain two distinct scheduled clusters. The first is the 12:30Z macro block, where core PCE, the second estimate of Q2 GDP and durable goods print together; conditional Tail is modelled at 21-22% through the release and the 13:30Z US cash open, mapping to a yellow WATCH state, before easing back through the US morning. The second is the Nvidia sequence, with results expected shortly after the 20:00Z close and the analyst call at 21:00Z, where conditional Tail is modelled at 26-27% and crosses into the orange BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES band for 20:00-22:00 UTC, then steps down through the Asian session. Between and after those clusters the modelled path returns toward a 13-18% baseline. All forward structure is conditional: no post-release or post-earnings price path is treated as observed, and an orderly path with visible retracements would justify faster decay than modelled here.
